project.label: FOS
project.description: May every child of humanity returning to Earth be safe.
controller.Android.label: Android
controller.Android.description:
Android emulators only; the official emulator is not supported.

Turn off notch (cutout) adaptation in the game's settings.
controller.Win32-Window.label: PC - Standard
controller.Win32-Window.description:
Standard PC mode with better compatibility; occasionally takes over the mouse.

Requires administrator privileges.

Set the program path to the game executable PGR.exe, not the launcher's launcher.exe.
controller.Win32-Window-Background.label: PC - Background
controller.Win32-Window-Background.descr:
PC background mode: never takes over the mouse. The game must be in windowed mode.

Requires administrator privileges.

Set the program path to the game executable PGR.exe, not the launcher's launcher.exe.
controller.Win32-Window-Front.label: PC - Foreground
controller.Win32-Window-Front.descriptio:
PC foreground mode: takes over the mouse, but has the best compatibility.

Requires administrator privileges.

Set the program path to the game executable PGR.exe, not the launcher's launcher.exe.
controller.PlayCover.label: PlayCover
controller.PlayCover.description:
macOS only, via PlayCover.

PlayCover cannot launch the game by itself.
resource.zh_CN.label: Simplified Chinese
resource.zh_CN.description: Choose this for the CN server / Simplified Chinese client.
resource.zh_TW.label: Traditional Chinese
resource.zh_TW.description:
The TW server and the Steam Traditional Chinese client (window title 「戰雙帕彌什」) must use this, otherwise OCR looks for Simplified Chinese text and tasks get stuck.

This is separate from setting the interface language to Traditional Chinese: make sure "Traditional Chinese" is selected in the resource dropdown.
resource.ja_JP.label: Japanese
resource.ja_JP.description: The JP client must use this, otherwise OCR looks for Simplified Chinese text and tasks get stuck.

task.战斗辅助.description:
Combat mode

  • Auto-detect: switches between continuous combat and idling based on the current battle.
  • Continuous combat: stays in continuous combat and does not pause when no enemies are present.

Recommendations

  • If the stage involves puzzles or exploration while your character is still in combat, use Auto-detect.
  • If the stage has no story or puzzles and fighting starts as soon as you enter the map, but your character isn't attacking, use Continuous combat.

Speedrun mode

  • On: automatically selects the next chapter, tries to turn on speedrun mode, then enters the battle or story.
  • Off: does not select the next chapter.

Skip story

  • Yes: skips story automatically.
  • No: does not skip story.
option.战斗模式.description:
Combat mode

  • Auto-detect: switches between continuous combat and idling based on the current battle.
  • Continuous combat: always stays in continuous combat and never pauses when no enemies are present.

Recommendations

  • If the stage involves puzzles or exploration while your character is still in combat, use Auto-detect.
  • If the stage has no story or puzzles and fighting starts as soon as you enter the map, but your character isn't attacking, use Continuous combat.
option.选择人物.description: Choose the character to fight with; if not found, one is chosen automatically.
task.宣叙妄响.description:
Mastery difficulty is recommended.

Characters currently supported for auto-combat: Stigmata, Lost Lullaby, Crimson Weave, Hyperreal.

This task does not claim the daily missions for you; claim them yourself.
task.厄愿潮声.description:
Normal difficulty or lower is recommended; higher difficulties may not be clearable.

Characters currently supported for auto-combat: Stigmata, Lost Lullaby, Crimson Weave, Hyperreal.
task.矩阵循生.description:
Once 4 points of starting recruitment energy are unlocked, characters are picked automatically.

If not yet unlocked: the first pick is a character with proficiency below 3; after the "New Owner" event, a character is picked automatically from those already recruited.
task.寒境曙光.description: Severe Frost and Starting Funds are recommended.
task.神寂启示录.description: Automatically runs The Godfall Revelation, farming with your chosen character and strategy.
